short_description: A home DLP projector on a large screen. The closest home experience to cinema geometry — but brightness and contrast vary widely by model and room conditions.

default_display_optics.contrast_notes: Home projector brightness and contrast vary widely by lamp/laser power, screen gain, and room light. Defaults here are low-confidence estimates for a mid-range DLP in a darkened room.

known_limitations: Brightness and contrast vary widely by model — treat defaults as low-confidence estimates
Ambient light dramatically reduces effective contrast — requires a truly dark room
Screen size and viewing distance must be set by the user — no sensible default exists
